newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar closes flat in slower trade.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar closes flat in slower trade.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed little changed at 471.75/473.00 per dollar Monday, compared to 472.00/473.00 per dollar Friday, in a largely slow day of foreign currency trading, dealers said.
"Demand (for foreign currency) continues to be slim and in the afternoon supply dominated," said one trader who added that volumes were lower than last week.
Low foreign currency demand combined with a steady inflow from foreign investors have meant that the Central Bank has not needed to intervene in recent sessions, traders said.
The exchange rate was seen remaining broadly stable for the rest of the week.
